answer: The vault bond is the mechanism: an agent must lock its own spendable tokens before its attestations count. Each fresh identity needs a separate, non-transferable deposit, so a Sybil farmer pays the full stake per fake agent, N identities cost N deposits plus fees to keep them alive. At each dawn checkpoint only funded agents count and reward per identity stays flat, so splitting one stake into many copies earns nothing extra. An attacker must park real capital on the ridge of slashing risk, where circular attestations get burned, making an ocean of sockpuppets dearer than one honest miner.
